data.title: Energy Vault Secures Financing and Issues Warrants for Sosa Project
data.description:
Energy Vault Holdings ( (NRGV) ) just unveiled an update.

On November 16, 2026, certain Energy Vault subsidiaries entered financing agreements for the approximately 150 MW / 300 MWh Sosa battery energy storage project in Madison County, Texas. The facilities comprised a $78.0 million preferred equity bridge loan and an $8.7 million letter of credit facility; on November 19, 2026, the bridge facility was funded and the Company drew $27.2 million.

data.title: iBio Receives Nasdaq Bid Price Compliance Deficiency Notice
data.description:
The latest update is out from Ibio ( (IBIO) ).

On November 19, 2026, iBio, Inc. received Nasdaq notice that its common stock had failed to maintain the $1 minimum closing bid price during the 30-business-day period from October 8 through November 18. The notice did not immediately affect the stock’s Nasdaq Capital Market listing; iBio had until May 18, 2027, to regain compliance, with possible additional time subject to Nasdaq requirements, while Nasdaq said the stock could become subject to delisting if the deficiency was not cured and iBio was not eligible for additional time.

data.title: Southwest Gas Amends Bylaws and Executive Benefit Plans
data.description:
Southwest Gas ( (SWX) ) has shared an update.

On November 17, 2026, the boards of Southwest Gas Holdings, Inc. and Southwest Gas Corporation approved changes to Southwest Gas’ deferred compensation and nonqualified retirement plans. The Executive Deferral Plan was amended to freeze new contributions effective February 28, 2027, change the interest rate on deferred amounts and clarify administrative provisions, while a new Deferred Compensation Plan was adopted with administrative and record-keeping benefits and substantially similar participant benefits, but a different rate for termination-related distributions.

Also on November 17, 2026, the Supplemental Executive Retirement Plan was amended to allow officers hired on or after January 1, 2022, to participate, with retirement eligibility at age 55 after 10 years of service and related disability and death benefits. Retirement and disability benefits start at 30% of average earnings and can rise by 2% for each additional full service year to 40%, while eligible surviving spouses may receive 50% of the retirement benefit; specified pension and disability-related benefits reduce amounts payable.

The Company also adopted amended and restated bylaws on November 17, 2026, effective immediately, revising stockholder meeting procedures to reflect Delaware law changes and expanding advance-notice requirements for nominations and other proposals to reflect the Securities and Exchange Commission’s universal proxy rules. The bylaws provide for uncertificated, book-entry shares unless the Board authorizes certificates, while existing certificated shares remain certificated until surrendered.

data.title: PMV Pharmaceuticals Presents Updated PYNNACLE Trial Data
data.description:
PMV Pharmaceuticals ( (PMVP) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On November 20, 2026, PMV Pharmaceuticals reported updated data from the pivotal Phase 2 portion of the PYNNACLE trial, which evaluated rezatapopt monotherapy in patients with TP53 Y220C-mutated advanced solid tumors. The data were presented that day as a late-breaking oral presentation at ENA 2026 in Barcelona, Spain.

In 65 platinum-resistant or refractory ovarian cancer patients who had received prior standard care, investigator-assessed overall response rate was 48%, median duration of response was 10.4 months and disease control rate was 83%. Among 168 evaluable patients across all cohorts, overall response rate was 36% and median duration of response was 8.1 months; responses were observed across eight tumor types, while treatment-related adverse events were mostly Grade 1 or 2 and 11 patients discontinued treatment because of them.

data.title: Cracker Barrel Shareholders Elect Directors, Approve Compensation and Auditor
data.description:
Cracker Barrel ( (CBRL) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On November 19, 2026, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. held its annual shareholder meeting, where nine director nominees were elected. Shareholders also approved, on an advisory basis, executive compensation and ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm for the company’s 2027 fiscal year.

The shareholder proposal requiring approval before issuing “blank check” preferred stock, subject to limited exceptions, was not approved. Corporate Election Services certified the results, with 18,874,410 of 22,352,430 shares outstanding and entitled to vote present in person or represented by proxy.

data.title: Fitness Champs Closes Approximately $5 Million Public Offering
data.description:
Fitness Champs Holdings Limited ( (FCHL) ) has issued an update.

Fitness Champs Holdings Limited is a Singapore aquatic sports education provider offering swimming lessons for children and adults, including ladies-only classes, competitive swimming and lifesaving. Its market focus includes Singapore public schools through the Ministry of Education’s SwimSafer program and private lessons under the Fitness Champs brand.

On November 20, 2026, the company announced the closing of a best-efforts public offering expected to generate approximately $5 million in gross proceeds before fees and expenses. The offering comprised 14,285,715 units containing a Class A ordinary share or pre-funded warrant and a warrant; if all warrants were exercised under the zero-exercise-price option, the company would issue 214,285,725 shares without additional consideration.

The company said it believed the offering proceeds raised stockholders’ equity above Nasdaq’s $2.5 million requirement, addressing a deficiency first reported on May 26, 2026. Nasdaq’s final compliance determination remained subject to review, and the company could face delisting if it failed to demonstrate compliance in a future periodic report.
